findings.description: Direct inspection of V207 crouch and sit renders shows both thighs projecting in front of the overskirt, exposing the shorts and leaving the lap uncovered. The lilac hem doubles back behind the knees and pointed panels hang below the seat.

Standing front, three-quarter and side images show angular creases across the front pleats. In prone, the rear panel covers the upper thighs but the front fabric bunches beneath the hips into overlapping folds.
Arms-up render shows a small gray patch at the viewer-right inner upper arm. Its cause is uncertain from the image; sleeve opening or rendering gap is not classified as proven.

nextAction: Keep V207 rejected. The unified panel Cloth and full-component pre-Cloth weight transfer completed, but direct crouch/sit images still expose both thighs and show a doubled hem, while front pleats remain angular and prone fabric bunches beneath the hips. Change the deformation or panel geometry based on these visible failures, rebuild, and inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Key response, production rig/weights, Unity/VRChat, package and release remain unverified.
